milestones.title: Core Implementation (RAG Engine, Vector Store, CLI, UI)

tasks.goal: Define end-to-end system architecture, API contracts, module boundaries, and file ownership map for Simple RAG Pipeline
inputs: User specifications: PDF ingestion, chunking, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding, ChromaDB vector store, top-k retrieval, modular LLM generation, CLI, and Streamlit UI
acceptanceCriteria: architecture.json defines components: PDF Reader, Chunker, Embedder (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), VectorStore (ChromaDB), Query Engine, Generator (modular local/cloud LLM), CLI, Streamlit UI
api-contract.json defines public function signatures, data contracts, and REST/CLI/UI schemas
ownership-map.json sets strict file and directory ownership boundaries without overlaps

tasks.goal: Implement PDF ingestion, text extraction, text chunking, and ChromaDB vector store integration with sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
acceptanceCriteria: Extract text cleanly from input PDF files
Chunk text with configurable chunk size and overlap
Embed chunks using sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
Store chunks and embeddings in persistent or in-memory ChromaDB collection
Provide query method returning top-k nearest chunks with metadata and scores

tasks.goal: Implement modular LLM generator (local Hugging Face / Transformers, mock/fallback, and optional API key support) and main RAG orchestrator pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Modular generator class supporting pluggable backends (HuggingFace transformer pipeline, Gemini/OpenAI API, and local template fallback)
Construct prompt combining query and top-k context chunks
Pipeline orchestrates ingest(pdf_path) and query(user_query, top_k) seamlessly

tasks.goal: Build interactive CLI interface and Streamlit Web application for PDF upload, query input, top-k chunks inspection, and generated answer display
acceptanceCriteria: CLI provides interactive command prompt allowing user to specify PDF path, index it, and ask queries in an interactive loop
Streamlit UI provides file uploader, query input box, response view, and context chunks expander
Clear status indicators for ingestion and generation

tasks.goal: Integrate data pipeline, backend engine, CLI, and Streamlit UI; ensure clean module imports and sample PDF run
acceptanceCriteria: All components integrate cleanly without import errors
End-to-end smoke test succeeds on sample document
integration-report.json produced with status PASS

tasks.goal: Design and execute automated unit, integration, and contract tests for the RAG pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests for PDF reading, chunking, embedding, vector store retrieval, generator, and pipeline
All tests pass with high test coverage
qa-report.json produced with status PASS

tasks.goal: Audit RAG pipeline for security concerns (untrusted PDF parsing, prompt injection handling, environment variable protection, dependency hygiene)
acceptanceCriteria: Safe file path handling and PDF parsing limits
Prompt sanitization and context truncation safeguards
No hardcoded secrets or sensitive tokens in codebase
Formal security sign-off issued

tasks.goal: Create comprehensive documentation, usage examples, architecture overview, and setup guide
acceptanceCriteria: Step-by-step instructions for installing requirements and running CLI and Streamlit UI
Sample walkthrough with commands and sample query output
Architecture diagram and component breakdown

tasks.goal: Provide packaging, requirements.txt, environment setup (.env.example), run scripts, and release report
acceptanceCriteria: Pinned or bounded dependencies in requirements.txt
Ready-to-run batch scripts for Windows
release-report.json confirming release readiness
